subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Creates own patterns; copies pegboard patterns

show.line: Spring is here! Red peg, yellow peg, red peg, yellow peg. That is a pattern!

rounds.prompt: Red, yellow, red, yellow. What comes next?
Egg, chick, egg, chick. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Egg! Egg, chick, egg, chick, egg.

rounds.prompt: Copy my pegboard pattern. Which one is just the same?
rounds.praise: Yes! You copied it just right.

rounds.prompt: Flower, flower, leaf. Flower, flower, leaf. What comes next?
Blue, red, blue, red. What colour comes next? Say it.
Make your own pattern! Start with red, then yellow. Which peg comes next?
rounds.praise: Yes! Red, yellow, red. Your own pattern!

hints: Say the pattern out loud. Red, yellow, red, yellow.
Find the part that repeats. Then say it again.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Red, yellow, red, yellow.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Red, yellow, red, yellow, red. No blue!
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Red, yellow, red, yellow. Red comes next!

parent_line: Can copy a pattern and say what comes next.
